items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip injury; expected to return vs Eagles.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury report IN list; Schefter expected to play.
items.implication: WR2/3 upside returns, possible snap limits per Levitan.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in Rams offense vs depleted Eagles secondary/pass rush.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN; good to go vs Cowboys after hamstring.
items.why: ETR IN; Rapoport/Texans PR confirmed good to go.
items.implication: Elite WR1 spot; Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL) per Levitan.
items.opportunity: High target share in favorable DvP, Texans high implied points.

items.why: Schefter outs + Jets ruled out + ETR/Rapoport.
items.implication: Jets RB vacuum; Braelon Allen or others full snaps.

items.text: DeVonta Smith ruled OUT vs Rams with hamstring.
items.implication: Eagles WR corps thinned; worse with Goedert also out.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining Eagles WRs/TEs.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ruled OUT Sunday with sprained ankle.
items.implication: Major WR1 absence; boosts Addison and other Vikings pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Jordan Addison home vs borderline secondary.

items.text: Jordan Addison opportunity peaks with Jefferson OUT; home vs weak secondary.
items.why: Levitan: moment Addison truthers waited for; borderline NFL secondary.
items.implication: WR2/flex start with clear target bump.

items.text: Dallas Goedert OUT (with Smith and Baun) vs Rams.
items.why: ETR OUT list; Schefter outs include Goedert/Baun.
items.implication: Eagles offense significantly depleted without three key players per Levitan.
items.opportunity: TE streamers or remaining skill players elevate.

items.text: De'Von Achane OUT (season-ending ACL tear, IR).
items.why: ETR OUT; confirmed ACL by Schefter/Rapoport sources earlier in week.
items.implication: Season over; Dolphins backfield to Gordon/Wright.

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest); Charbonnet practicing but PUP-ineligible.
items.why: ETR OUT + Schefter; Levitan notes role erosion + injury + Charbonnet return practice.
items.implication: SEA RBs to Wilson/Holani short-term; Price long-term eye-test positive but tough start (lost GL/pass work, fumbles).
WAS QB to Mariota or backup; impacts team total/pass catchers.

items.text: Mike Evans (ribs) game-time decision; intends to play through it.
items.why: Shanahan GTD; Rapoport notes intends to play with padding, has before.
items.implication: Monitor; if out boosts Kittle etc.
items.opportunity: If IN, full WR role; if OUT, TE/WR elevation.

items.text: Lamar Jackson off injury report, ACTIVE/good to go vs Titans.
items.implication: QB1 locked in; full dual-threat usage.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out; top-10 play vs CLE.
items.why: Full workhorse; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton: low utilization (RB27), 3.5% targets, 42% snaps, 13% 3rd down; tough SEA run D.
items.why: Poor usage profile + SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd fewest).
